title.zh: 产品轮廓：让物件保持同一个物件
title.en: Product form: keep one object consistent

goal.zh: 产品运动时，仍能辨认轮廓、部件比例和标识位置。
goal.en: Preserve silhouette, component proportions and mark placement while the product moves.

inputs.zh: 正侧视图、部件名称、不可改变的比例、目标终帧。
inputs.en: Front and side references, named components, invariant proportions and a target final frame.

control.zh: 把产品身份与镜头指令分开；先列不变量，再限定单镜动作。
control.en: Separate product identity from camera instructions; define invariants before assigning one action per shot.

observation.zh: 产品广告模板将终帧构图与产品身份参考分工处理。这是文档结构的观察，不是本人的生成测试。
observation.en: The product-commercial template separates final-frame composition from product-identity references. This is a documentation observation, not a personal generation test.

limits.zh: 文字指令无法保证精确尺寸或商标；几何与文字仍需人工检查。
limits.en: Text instructions cannot guarantee dimensions or marks; geometry and lettering still need inspection.

transfer.zh: 用灯具的灯体截面、连接件和出光面建立核对清单，再讨论运镜。
transfer.en: For a luminaire, check the housing section, connectors and emitting surface before judging the camera move.

title.zh: CMF 与光线：让材质成为镜头目标
title.en: CMF and light: give material a shot objective

goal.zh: 用光线变化解释表面，而不只追求高光强度。
goal.en: Explain a surface through changing light rather than highlight intensity alone.

inputs.zh: 材料样本、粗糙度意图、主光方向、希望辨认的表面特征。
inputs.en: Material references, intended roughness, key-light direction and the surface feature to reveal.

control.zh: 一个镜头只验证一类表面现象，区分漫反射、边缘反光与透射。
control.en: Give each shot one material question; distinguish diffuse response, edge reflection and transmission.

observation.zh: 上游模板要求指定微距拍摄对象，并将风格词集中处理；可据此减少镜头目标混杂。
observation.en: The template asks for specific macro subjects and groups style instructions. This provides a way to reduce competing shot objectives.

limits.zh: 生成图像不能证明真实材料、制造工艺或物理参数。
limits.en: Generated imagery does not establish real materials, manufacturing processes or physical parameters.

transfer.zh: 在夜礼司概念评审中区分木、金属、透明材料的视觉意图；最终 CMF 决定仍依赖样本。
transfer.en: In YELISI concept review, distinguish wood, metal and transparent-material intentions; final CMF decisions still require samples.

reference.title: 巴厘岛梦幻夏日旅行日记
reference.creator: @eshal__ai

title.zh: 空间运动：先建立路径，再安排景别
title.en: Spatial movement: establish the path first

goal.zh: 镜头之间保留入口、目标与行动方向的关系。
goal.en: Preserve the relationship between entry, destination and movement direction.

inputs.zh: 平面路径、关键视点、主体位置、空间尺度参考。
inputs.en: A plan path, key viewpoints, subject positions and scale references.

control.zh: 先用白模定义每段路径的起止位置，再为每段指定景别与运动轴。
control.en: Define each path segment in blocking, then assign framing and a movement axis.

observation.zh: 城市行走模板按地点和时段组织段落；本研究将它转译为视点与空间节点的对应关系。
observation.en: The travel template organizes segments by place and time; this study translates that structure into viewpoints and spatial nodes.

limits.zh: 漂亮的连续镜头仍可能出现门洞、距离或朝向突变；文档描述不等于空间连续性验证。
limits.en: An attractive sequence can still change openings, distances or orientation. A written description is not spatial-continuity validation.

transfer.zh: 适用于橱窗与展陈的观看路径预演，不替代施工尺寸或现场验证。
transfer.en: Use it to preview viewing paths through windows and displays, not to replace construction dimensions or site checks.

reference.title: Seedance 2.5 多参考图锁定人物形象短片
reference.creator: @ElsaSofia__AI

title.zh: 角色一致性：明确继承与排除
title.en: Character consistency: specify what carries over

goal.zh: 跨镜头保留角色身份，同时允许姿态与构图变化。
goal.en: Carry identity across shots while allowing pose and composition to change.

inputs.zh: 角色参考图、服饰轮廓、颜色关系，以及不希望复制的姿态。
inputs.en: Character references, clothing silhouette, color relationships and poses that must not carry over.

control.zh: 为参考图分配独立职责；角色图管身份，分镜图管动作与构图。
control.en: Assign each reference a job: character images own identity; storyboard images own action and composition.

observation.zh: 身份锁定模板同时包含继承与排除要求，避免把身份一致误解成整张图的复制。
observation.en: The identity-lock template describes both inheritance and exclusions, separating identity consistency from copying a whole reference.

limits.zh: 多人场景仍可能串脸、换装或错误分配角色；未进行本人重复生成对照。
limits.en: Crowds may still swap faces, clothing or roles; no personal repeat-generation comparison is claimed.

transfer.zh: 对应个人22秒实践中的两张角色输入；未来可逐镜核对身份漂移。
transfer.en: Connects to the two character inputs in the personal 22-second study; identity drift can be checked shot by shot.

title.zh: 分镜衔接：把画面顺序变成动作关系
title.en: Storyboard hand-offs: connect actions, not just panels

goal.zh: 每个分镜结束时，为下个镜头提供可接续的状态。
goal.en: End each storyboard unit in a state the next shot can inherit.

inputs.zh: 编号分镜、总时长、单镜动作、上一镜结尾和下一镜开头。
inputs.en: Numbered panels, runtime, one action per shot and adjacent start/end states.

control.zh: 先检查分镜格数与总时长，再明确每格的动作、景别和交接条件。
control.en: Check panel count against runtime, then specify action, framing and hand-off conditions.

observation.zh: 网格转视频模板将分镜图与视频提示语分两阶段处理；本研究额外强调镜头之间的状态交接。
observation.en: The grid-to-video template separates storyboard creation from the video prompt; this study additionally emphasizes state hand-offs.

limits.zh: 格数与时长是输入约束，不能保证模型严格执行；作者描述的11格不等于独立验证。
limits.en: Panel count and runtime are input constraints, not execution guarantees. The author-described 11 units are not independently validated.

transfer.zh: 可将产品使用过程写成“接近—接触—操作—反馈”的连续状态。
transfer.en: Describe product use as connected states: approach, contact, operation and feedback.

reference.title: Seedance 2.5 生成菠萝披萨突袭执法记录仪长镜头
reference.creator: @techhalla

title.zh: 连续运镜：说明相机与主体的关系
title.en: Continuous camera: define its relation to the subject

goal.zh: 在不中断视线关系的前提下改变距离或方向。
goal.en: Change distance or direction while preserving a legible viewing relationship.

inputs.zh: 相机起终点、关注目标、路径、速度变化与遮挡条件。
inputs.en: Camera start/end positions, target, path, speed changes and occlusion conditions.

control.zh: 把相机运动和主体运动分别描述；先验证一条可读路径，再增加节奏变化。
control.en: Describe camera and subject motion separately; validate one readable path before adding tempo changes.

observation.zh: 连续镜头模板以不中断的视点运动组织描述；可用白模把含糊的“环绕”转成具体路径。
observation.en: The continuous-take template organizes the description around uninterrupted viewpoint movement. Blocking can turn a vague orbit into a specific path.

limits.zh: 写下“一镜到底”并不保证无隐藏切换或几何穿透。
limits.en: Writing “one continuous take” does not guarantee the absence of hidden cuts or geometry intersections.

transfer.zh: 为产品展示比较轨道环绕与产品自转，明确哪种更能说明结构。
transfer.en: Compare a camera orbit with product rotation, choosing the one that better explains structure.

reference.title: Seedance：不会有人认为这是真的吧？😄
reference.creator: @johnAGI168

title.zh: 动作物理：检查接触与受力链
title.en: Physical action: inspect contact and force

goal.zh: 让动作起因、接触、运动和结束状态可解释。
goal.en: Make initiation, contact, movement and the end state causally legible.

inputs.zh: 动作分解、接触点、支撑面、重心意图和终止条件。
inputs.en: Action breakdown, contact points, support surfaces, intended balance and stopping conditions.

control.zh: 逐段写出完整动作链；把漂浮、瞬移和接触丢失设为审阅项。
control.en: Write the action chain in order; review floating, teleportation and lost contact explicitly.

observation.zh: 运动模板将动作链和物理限制分别表达；它提供的是提示结构，不是物理仿真。
observation.en: The sports template separates action chains from physical constraints. It provides prompt structure, not physical simulation.

limits.zh: 生成结果不能证明承载、安全性、人体工学或工程可行性。
limits.en: Generated output cannot establish load capacity, safety, ergonomics or engineering feasibility.

transfer.zh: 在产品操作短片中检查手、按钮、关节和物件接触，避免用视觉效果代替可用性证据。
transfer.en: Check hand, button, joint and object contact in product-use films; visual polish is not usability evidence.

reference.title: 复古餐厅时间冻结与倒放
reference.creator: @techhalla

title.zh: 风格与时间：把效果变成可审阅规则
title.en: Style and time: turn effects into review rules

goal.zh: 区分视觉风格、时间顺序和需要保持不变的对象。
goal.en: Separate visual style, temporal order and objects that must remain invariant.

inputs.zh: 正向事件序列、冻结对象、倒放区间、风格参考与审阅清单。
inputs.en: Forward event sequence, frozen objects, rewind interval, style references and a review checklist.

control.zh: 先定义正常事件，再标出时间操作范围；审阅前后状态能否对应。
control.en: Define the normal event first, mark the temporal-operation interval, then compare its boundary states.

observation.zh: 时间冻结模板对不同时间状态作区分；本研究将其转为可复用的前后状态检查。
observation.en: The time-freeze template distinguishes temporal states; this study converts that idea into a reusable boundary-state check.

limits.zh: 单个成功样片不等于稳定性；上游复测也不是本人的实验成绩。
limits.en: The reference example supports a repeatable review question: what changes when the same control is applied across another shot?

transfer.zh: 用于产品拆装或变形概念预演时，标明哪些是编辑效果，哪些是结构设计意图。
transfer.en: For assembly or transformation previews, distinguish editorial effects from structural design intentions.
